name: Osei Threadmark Beaded Data Necklace
description:
Thirty-seven hand-knotted beads of varying diameter — volcanic glass, compressed bone resin, and a few unmistakable matte-black data capsules — strung on braided stainless micro-cable. The beads alternate matte and semi-gloss in no apparent pattern, but the data capsules (four of them, positioned at irregular intervals) are indistinguishable from the decorative glass unless you know what to feel for.

Each capsule is a standard 2mm micro-port data chip encased in polished resin, readable by any compatible neck-port or handheld reader. Worn as a statement piece that is also a filing system.
functionality: Four embedded 8TB data capsules readable via standard micro-port or handheld scanner. Stainless cable is rated for 40kg tensile before clasp release. Clasp is a manual friction lock, not magnetic — harder to accidentally trigger.
what_it_says: This person keeps what matters close to the body, hidden in plain sight, and has a cultural inheritance that doesn't separate beauty from function.
story_hooks: The studio's founder disappeared eight months ago; the current line is being run by someone who refuses to confirm or deny being the same person.
A data capsule from one of these necklaces surfaced in a Tier 5 evidence file — the contents haven't been disclosed.
Customs scanners at Spire-adjacent transit hubs have been reprogrammed to flag the specific resin signature of these capsules.

physical_description.visual_profile: A layered statement necklace that drapes across the collarbone and upper chest, mixing artisanal craft with hidden tech functionality. The irregular bead spacing creates visual rhythm; the piece reads as organic and handmade while concealing practical utility. Suggests someone who blurs street culture with underground data networks.
physical_description.fit: One-size, adjusted length approximately 16-20 inches depending on wearer neck/shoulder size. Sits naturally at the collarbone, weight distributed across micro-cable so no pressure points. Flexible drape allows repositioning of beads along the cable.
physical_description.primary_material: Braided stainless steel micro-cable (0.8mm diameter) strung with volcanic glass beads, compressed bone resin components, and four integrated 2mm data capsule micro-ports sealed in translucent polished resin
physical_description.texture: Beads range from smooth semi-gloss to matte volcanic glass (slightly rough, almost sandy to touch). Bone resin beads have subtle organic grain visible under light. Data capsules feel imperceptibly different — harder, smoother resin exterior. Cable is fine but has slight grip texture for security.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primarily warm grays and charcoal from volcanic glass and bone resin, with cool industrial silver from the stainless cable. Matte-black data capsules are the only true darks, deliberately understated. Overall palette is monochromatic street-luxe with subtle iridescent sheen on semi-gloss beads under directional light.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit magnetic clasp (hidden, built into two largest bone resin beads on reverse side of necklace). No visible closure — seamless loop appearance when worn.
distinctive_features: Four embedded micro-data capsules (2mm) containing readable information — indistinguishable from decorative beads unless felt
Hand-knotted spacing between beads (knots visible on micro-cable at intervals)
Volcanic glass and bone resin sources suggest reclaimed/organic material sourcing
Irregular bead diameter and pattern — deliberate handcraft asymmetry
No visible branding; Osei Threadmark reputation is word-of-mouth street credibility
Data capsules are standard compatible format — readable by most neck-ports or handheld readers
Each bead shows subtle variation suggesting individual artisan work
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 crossover. Street-label handcraft price point (Φ200-400), but the integrated data-port functionality and material quality suggest someone with access and technical knowledge. Too refined for Tier 5 salvage, too street-authentic for Tier 2 corpo luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by underground data couriers, street artists, hacktivist nodes, and information brokers who need plausible deniability. The piece says: 'I carry secrets, I value craft, I operate outside corpo supply chains.' Popular in squatter collectives and independent maker communities across the GLMZ. Also favored by augmentation-averse data professionals who resist internal implants but need portable storage.
physical_description.condition_typical: Slightly worn volcanic glass showing micro-scratches from contact and wear. Bone resin beads develop patina over months. Stainless cable remains bright but may show slight kinking near clasp from repeated handling. Data capsules stay matte unless deliberately buffed. Worn pieces show tightness in knots from movement. Usually kept clean but not polished — street aesthetic values broken-in authenticity.

Close-up shot emphasizing bead texture variation — volcanic glass matte surfaces catching moody blue-amber overhead lighting, stainless cable gleaming subtly, the four black data capsules barely visible among gray-tone beads.
